   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  June 8, 2026

Chair Ang called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m. and Commissioner Garcia led the Flag Salute.
Responding to roll call were Chair Ang, Commissioner Garcia, and Commissioner Sanchez. Vice Chair
Lopez was absent. Also present was Levy Sun, Director of Communications, Alex Ocegueda, Office
Assistant III, and Laura Zaldivar, Community Information Assistant.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Sanchez made the motion and Commissioner Garcia seconded to approve the minutes
for May 11, 2026. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Native Garden Contest

Mrs. Ocegueda informed the Commission that three (3) entries in total were received for the contest.
Mrs. Ocegueda showed Commissioners the submitted photos for each address and provided a score
sheet. Mrs. Ocegueda stated she will contact the winners to schedule a visit to give them their prizes
and get pictures for future promotion of the contest.

Commissioners Appreciation Dinner

Ms. Ocegueda asked Commissioners to be at the event by 5:15 pm and confirmed that two council
members will be in attendance. Mrs. Ocegueda also confirmed that the catering will be provided by
the Norwalk High School Catering team and will be arriving to set up by 5:15 pm.

Keepin’ It Norwalk

Miss Zaldivar presented the “Keepin’ It Norwalk” campaign video, May Flower Shop edition, to the
Commissioners.

Communications Analytics

Miss Zaldivar and Mr. Sun presented monthly performance metrics across digital platforms. The
Commission received and filed the report.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Commissioner Sanchez detailed his experience at Mr. Rosewood’s anniversary celebration.
Commissioner Garcia asked regarding the Commission’s booth at the Independence Day Festival.
Mrs. Ocegueda confirmed a booth will be set up for both the Independence Day Festival and the three
summer concerts. She will email the Commission with event and parking information. Chair Ang
detailed his experience attending the Memorial Day event and the John Glenn High School Spring
concert.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 6:38 p.m.

_____________________________

David Ang, Chair
